title: 出貨延誤的客訴電話

dialogue.text: Hi, this is Daniel Foster from Brightway Furniture. I'm calling about our order. It was supposed to arrive on Monday, and it's still not here.
I'm sorry about that, Mr. Foster. Let me pull up your account. Can you give me the order number?
Sure. It's four seven two nine zero.
Thanks. Okay, I see it. Well, it looks like the shipment left our warehouse late. There was a problem with our delivery company last week.
That's a real problem for us. We've got customers waiting on those chairs.
I understand. The good news is it's on the truck now. It should get to you Thursday morning.
Thursday? That's three days late. Can you do anything about the shipping cost?
Actually, yes. I can take the shipping fee off your invoice. That's about ninety dollars.
Okay, that helps. And can you send me something in writing?
Of course. I'll email you the updated invoice and the tracking number this afternoon.
Great. One more thing. Next time, could someone call us if there's a delay?
Absolutely. I'll add a note to your account so you get a call right away.

options: To place a new order
To ask about a late delivery
To return some damaged chairs
To change a shipping address
questions.explanation: 定位在男子開頭第一句：I'm calling about our order. It was supposed to arrive on Monday, and it's still not here.（我打來是問訂單,原本星期一該到,到現在還沒收到）。他打電話的目的就是追一批遲到的貨,選 (B)。(A) 他沒有要下新單;(C) 對話中椅子沒有損壞,只是還沒送到;(D) 全程沒有提到更改地址。

questions.q: According to the woman, what caused the problem?
options: A computer system error
A shortage of materials
Bad weather
An issue with the delivery company
questions.explanation: 定位在女子第二次發言：the shipment left our warehouse late. There was a problem with our delivery company last week.（貨出倉庫就晚了,上週我們的物流公司出了狀況）。原因是物流商出問題,選 (D)。其餘三個選項都是常見的延誤理由,但對話中完全沒提到。

questions.q: What will the woman do this afternoon?
options: Send an email with the updated invoice
Call the delivery driver
Visit the man's store
Refund the full amount of the order
questions.explanation: 定位在女子倒數第二次發言：I'll email you the updated invoice and the tracking number this afternoon.（我今天下午會把更新後的帳單和追蹤號碼寄給您）。題目問下午要做的事,選 (A)。(D) 是陷阱：她只說免掉約九十美元的運費（take the shipping fee off your invoice）,不是全額退款。

transcriptZh: 男：您好，我是 Brightway 家具的 Daniel Foster。我打來是想問我們的訂單，原本應該星期一就到，現在還沒收到。 女：Foster 先生，真的很抱歉。我幫您調一下資料，可以給我訂單編號嗎？ 男：好，是四七二九零。 女：謝謝。好，我看到了。嗯，看起來這批貨從我們倉庫出去的時間就晚了，上週我們的物流公司出了狀況。 男：這對我們來說很麻煩，有客人在等那些椅子。 女：我了解。好消息是貨已經在車上了，星期四早上應該就會送到。 男：星期四？那晚了三天。運費的部分能不能想想辦法？ 女：其實可以。我可以把運費從您的帳單上扣掉，大概九十美元。 男：好，這樣有幫助。可以給我一份書面的嗎？ 女：當然。我今天下午會把更新後的帳單和追蹤號碼寄到您信箱。 男：太好了。還有一件事，下次如果延誤，可以請人打電話通知我們嗎？ 女：沒問題。我會在您的帳戶加上註記，這樣一有狀況就會馬上打給您。

title: 同事討論行銷職缺的面試人選

dialogue.text: Hey Marcus, got a minute? I want to talk about the interviews for the marketing position.
Sure. We saw four people yesterday, right?
Right. Honestly, I think it's between Karen Wu and the guy who came in last.
Peter Nakamura. Yeah, he had great ideas about social media.
He did. But he's only been working two years, and the job posting said five.
True. Karen has the experience, but she seemed a little quiet in the interview.
I noticed that too. So I called one of her references this morning.
Oh? What did they say?
Very positive. Her old manager said she leads a team of six and handles big clients.
Then maybe she was just nervous. Should we bring her back for a second round?
Yes, with the director this time. Can you check his calendar and set something up for next week?
No problem. I'll send you both an invitation this afternoon.

questions.q: What are the speakers mainly discussing?
options: A change to a job posting
A marketing campaign for a new client
Which job candidate to move forward with
A training program for new employees
questions.explanation: 主旨題要聽前兩三句：女子說 I want to talk about the interviews for the marketing position，接著說 I think it's between Karen Wu and the guy who came in last（我覺得就是這兩個人在比）。整段都在比較兩位應徵者、決定下一步，選 (C)。(A) job posting 只是被拿來當條件引用，沒有要修改;(B)(D) 對話中沒出現。

questions.q: What does the woman say about Peter Nakamura?
options: He does not have enough years of experience
He asked for a higher salary than expected
He arrived late for his interview
He is not familiar with social media
questions.explanation: 定位在女子第三次發言：he's only been working two years, and the job posting said five.（他只工作兩年，職缺公告寫的是五年）。年資不符要求，選 (A)。(D) 剛好講反：男子說 he had great ideas about social media，他社群這塊很強;(C) 是把 the guy who came in last（最後一位進來面試的人）誤聽成遲到。

questions.q: What will the man most likely do next?
options: Call Karen's former manager
Rewrite the job posting
Interview two more candidates
Arrange a meeting with the director
questions.explanation: 定位在最後兩句：女子說 Can you check his calendar and set something up for next week?，男子回 No problem. I'll send you both an invitation this afternoon.（沒問題，下午我把邀請寄給你們兩位）。他要去安排與總監的面談，選 (D)。(A) 打電話給前主管的是女子，而且已經在今天早上做完了。

transcriptZh: 女：嘿 Marcus，有空嗎？我想談一下行銷職缺的面試。 男：好啊。我們昨天看了四個人，對吧？ 女：對。老實說，我覺得就是 Karen Wu 跟最後進來的那位在比。 男：Peter Nakamura。對，他對社群媒體的想法很不錯。 女：確實。可是他才工作兩年，職缺公告寫的是五年。 男：也是。Karen 資歷夠，不過她在面試裡看起來有點安靜。 女：我也注意到了。所以我今天早上打給她其中一位推薦人。 男：喔？他們怎麼說？ 女：非常正面。她以前的主管說她帶六個人的團隊，還負責大客戶。 男：那她可能只是緊張而已。我們要不要請她回來進行第二輪面試？ 女：要，這次讓總監一起。你可以查一下他的行事曆，約在下週嗎？ 男：沒問題。我下午把邀請寄給你們兩位。

title: 藥局取藥與用藥諮詢

dialogue.text: Hi, I'm here to pick up a prescription. The name is Alan Reyes.
Let me check. Reyes. Yes, here it is. It was ready this morning.
Great. Actually, can I ask you something? My doctor didn't really explain how to take it.
Sure, go ahead.
How many do I take a day?
One tablet twice a day, once in the morning and once at night. And take it with food.
With food? Okay. What happens if I forget one?
Just take it when you remember. But if it's almost time for the next one, skip it. Don't take two at once.
Got it. And can I take this with the cold medicine I bought here last week?
Let me look that up. You should be fine, but wait about four hours between them.
Perfect. Oh, and how much is it?
With your insurance, it's twelve dollars. You can pay at the register over there.

questions.q: Where does the conversation most likely take place?
options: At a pharmacy
At a doctor's office
At a hospital cafeteria
At an insurance company
questions.explanation: 場景題：男子開口就說 I'm here to pick up a prescription（我來領處方藥），女子後面提到 tablet、cold medicine、pay at the register，是藥局的典型情境，選 (A)。(B) 醫生只是被提到 my doctor didn't really explain，人不在現場;(D) insurance 只出現在結帳時的 With your insurance。

questions.q: What does the woman tell the man to do if he misses a dose?
options: Call his doctor right away
Take two tablets the next time
Skip it if the next dose is coming soon
Stop taking the medicine for one day
questions.explanation: 定位在女子第四次發言：if it's almost time for the next one, skip it. Don't take two at once.（如果快到下一次的時間就跳過，不要一次吃兩顆）。選 (C)。(B) 正是女子明確否定的做法，屬於直接反向陷阱。

questions.q: What will the man most likely do next?
options: Return the cold medicine
Go to the register to pay
Make an appointment with his doctor
Wait four hours before leaving
questions.explanation: 下一步題看結尾：女子說 it's twelve dollars. You can pay at the register over there.（十二美元，可以到那邊的櫃檯結帳）。所以他接著會去付錢，選 (B)。(D) 的四小時是指兩種藥之間要間隔，不是要在現場等。

transcriptZh: 男：您好，我來領處方藥，名字是 Alan Reyes。 女：我查一下。Reyes。有，在這裡，今天早上就配好了。 男：太好了。其實我想問一下，我的醫生沒有很清楚說明要怎麼吃。 女：好啊，您問。 男：一天要吃幾顆？ 女：一天兩次，一次一顆，早上一次、晚上一次。要跟食物一起吃。 男：跟食物一起？好。那如果忘了吃一次呢？ 女：想起來的時候補吃就好。但如果快到下一次的時間了就跳過，不要一次吃兩顆。 男：了解。還有，這個可以跟我上週在這裡買的感冒藥一起吃嗎？ 女：我查一下。應該沒問題，不過兩種之間要間隔大約四小時。 男：太好了。喔對，這個多少錢？ 女：用您的保險是十二美元。可以到那邊的櫃檯結帳。

title: 辦公室搬遷的準備工作

dialogue.text: Ken, did you see the email about the office move?
I saw it, but I only read half of it. We're moving next month, right?
The weekend of the fifteenth. The moving company comes in Saturday morning.
So we just leave everything on our desks?
No, that's why I wanted to talk to you. Everyone has to pack their own boxes by Friday.
Okay. Where do we get boxes?
They're in the supply room now. Take as many as you need, and there are labels too.
Got it. What about the computers?
The IT team handles those. Don't unplug anything yourself. They'll come by on Thursday to tag them.
Good, because I really didn't want to do that. What's the new place like?
It's on Sherman Avenue, about ten minutes from here. More meeting rooms, and there's parking underneath.
Parking? That alone makes it worth it.

questions.q: What are the speakers mainly discussing?
options: A change in weekend working hours
A problem with the supply room
A new company parking policy
Preparations for moving to a new office
questions.explanation: 主旨題：女子開頭問 did you see the email about the office move?，之後談的都是搬家日期、打包、電腦、新地點，選 (D)。(A) Saturday morning 只是搬家公司來的時間，不是員工要加班;(C) 停車只在最後被順帶提到，是新辦公室的優點之一。

questions.q: What does the woman say employees must do by Friday?
options: Order new office furniture
Pack their own boxes
Meet with the moving company
Return their office keys
questions.explanation: 定位在女子第三次發言：Everyone has to pack their own boxes by Friday.（每個人星期五前都要自己把箱子打包好）。選 (B)。注意時間陷阱：星期四是 IT 來貼標籤，星期六才是搬家公司進場。

questions.q: What does the woman say about the computers?
options: They will be replaced at the new office
They should be packed with the labels provided
The IT team will take care of them
They must be unplugged on Friday
questions.explanation: 定位在女子第五次發言：The IT team handles those. Don't unplug anything yourself.（電腦由資訊部處理，不要自己拔線）。選 (C)。(D) 剛好是女子明講不要做的事;(B) 的 labels 是給紙箱用的，不是給電腦。

transcriptZh: 女：Ken，你看到辦公室搬遷那封信了嗎？ 男：看到了，不過只讀了一半。我們下個月要搬，對吧？ 女：十五號那個週末。搬家公司星期六早上會來。 男：所以東西就放在桌上不用管？ 女：不是，這就是我想找你談的原因。每個人星期五前都要自己把箱子打包好。 男：好。紙箱去哪裡拿？ 女：現在都放在文具室，需要多少拿多少，還有標籤可以用。 男：了解。那電腦呢？ 女：電腦由資訊部處理，不要自己拔線。他們星期四會過來貼標籤。 男：那太好了，我本來就不想弄。新的地方怎麼樣？ 女：在 Sherman 大道，離這裡大概十分鐘。會議室變多了，樓下還有停車場。 男：有停車位？光這點就值得了。

title: 產品發表會的場地與人數調整

dialogue.text: Sofia, I just got the numbers back for the product launch. A hundred and eighty people have confirmed.
A hundred and eighty? We booked the hall for a hundred and fifty.
I know. That's why I came to you first.
Hmm. Well, the hotel has a bigger room on the second floor, but I'd guess it costs more.
I already asked. It's another six hundred, and they need an answer by Friday.
Six hundred. That's more than I wanted to spend, but turning people away looks worse.
My thought exactly. And there's the catering. They're planning for a hundred and fifty too.
Right, we'd have to call them as well. Okay, let's take the bigger room. I'll clear it with Mr. Duval.
Do you think he'll say yes?
He signed off on a similar change last spring, so probably. I'll talk to him this afternoon.
Great. Once you hear back, I'll confirm with the hotel and update the catering order.
And send me the new floor plan when you get it. I want to see where the demo tables go.

questions.q: What problem are the speakers discussing?
options: A speaker canceled at the last minute
The catering company raised its prices
More guests are coming than the room can hold
The product is not ready for the launch
questions.explanation: 問題點在前兩句：男子說 A hundred and eighty people have confirmed，女子回 We booked the hall for a hundred and fifty.（我們訂的場地是一百五十人）。報名人數超過場地容量，選 (C)。(B) 加價的是飯店的大場地（another six hundred），不是餐飲公司;餐飲只是需要跟著改人數。

questions.q: Why does the woman think Mr. Duval will approve the change?
options: He suggested the larger room himself
He will be speaking at the launch
The department's budget was increased
He approved a similar request before
questions.explanation: 推論題定位在女子倒數第二次發言：He signed off on a similar change last spring, so probably.（他去年春天批准過類似的變更，所以應該會）。她的判斷依據是前例，選 (D)。sign off on 就是核准的口語說法。(C) 是反向：女子說 That's more than I wanted to spend，預算是吃緊而非增加。

questions.q: What does the woman ask the man to send her?
options: An updated guest list
The new floor plan
The catering invoice
A price quote from the hotel
questions.explanation: 定位在最後一句：send me the new floor plan when you get it. I want to see where the demo tables go.（拿到新的平面圖就寄給我，我想看展示桌要擺哪裡）。選 (B)。(D) 的報價男子早就問過了（I already asked），女子沒有再要一份。

transcriptZh: 男：Sofia，產品發表會的人數統計出來了，有一百八十人確認出席。 女：一百八十？我們訂的場地是一百五十人的。 男：我知道，所以我先來找你。 女：嗯。飯店二樓有一間比較大的，不過我猜會比較貴。 男：我已經問過了。要多六百塊，而且他們星期五前要答覆。 女：六百。比我原本想花的多，不過把人擋在外面更難看。 男：我也是這麼想。還有餐飲那邊，他們也是照一百五十人準備的。 女：對，那邊也要打電話。好，就換大的那間，我去跟 Duval 先生報備。 男：你覺得他會答應嗎？ 女：他去年春天批准過類似的變更，應該會。我今天下午找他談。 男：好。你那邊有消息，我就跟飯店確認，順便改餐飲的訂單。 女：還有，拿到新的平面圖就寄給我，我想看展示桌要擺在哪裡。
